verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a SaaS platform with client SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack contains GitHub README snippets for the purchases-ios SDK, but none of them state an open license or say the source is openly licensed. They describe SDK features only, so the story's requirement of source under an open license is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
